content.text: Quick update: I've gone through all 12 screenshots. Now I'm writing up what Maya took from them.

input.answer: My answer: there's a long list of stuff the site can't calculate yet, all tagged "לא מחושב": gold funds (השקעה בזהב דרך קרנות סל, ETC), אג"ח, foreign-currency stuff (פיקדון מט"ח, צמוד דולר, מנוטרלת מט"ח, עמלת חליפין), structured deposits, REITs, a digital investment portfolio, and a pile of insurance and pension things. Below that it says it never does loans, picking stocks, ranking funds by past returns ("דירוג לפי תשואה בעבר"), or buying for you. My plain index-fund thing isn't on the list, so I guess that part is covered. But it won't tell me which fund went up most, and that's how I'd usually pick.

stuck.why: "החוקים והכללים לכל המוצרים כאן עוד בבדיקה": does that mean the info under each card is wrong, or just not done yet? It made me trust the cards less

stuck.where: Cards with 'מצב הכיסוי' open (e.g. השקעה בזהב דרך קרנות סל)
stuck.why: 'חסום: שאלה פתוחה', crossed-out 'נסגר ב-' dates and codes like MF-28, TX2-01, TXA-28. No idea what that means for me
Endless cards about insurance, debt settlements and annuities. Got bored and just scrolled for headings

stuck.where: עמלת חליפין card vs. the securities-account guide
stuck.why: Here it's 'לא מחושב', but the guide had a whole 'המרת מטבע' fee row with company examples. Not exactly a contradiction, but I couldn't tell how much it actually covers

used: Title 'מה האתר עוד לא מכסה' and its subtitle
Red banner about rules still being checked
Card headings and the red 'לא מחושב' tags
Bottom section 'מה האתר לא משווה ולא עושה' and its bullet list
Memory of the securities-account guide (cost table, glossary)
skimmed: Insurance and pension cards (ביטוח מנהלים, קופת ביטוח, קרן י', תיקון 190, היוון קצבה, קצבה מוכרת, תשלומים פטורים)
Cards about foreign currency and dollars
skipped: Green law citations and source links
unsure_meaning: לא מחושב: not calculated, or not covered at all?
נסגר ב- with a crossed-out date
מק"מ-like terms: נע"מ / ניירות ערך מסחריים
not_found: A clear yes/no on whether regular index funds / קרן מחקה on S&P or Nasdaq are fully covered
Anything about whether small monthly amounts (300–500 ₪) are worth it

findings.what: The banner says the rules for every product here are 'עוד בבדיקה', yet every card shows a 'מקור ראשי' and law citations. I can't tell whether the cards are reliable
עמלת חליפין is tagged 'לא מחושב' here, but the securities-account guide has a 'המרת מטבע' fee row with example companies and defines עמלת חליפין in its glossary. Hard to know what's actually covered
findings.where: עמלת חליפין card (screen 5) vs. brokerage guide 'כמה זה עולה' / 'מונחים'

findings.what: A huge wall of nearly identical dark cards, mostly insurance and pension stuff. Way too long on a phone
Internal codes and crossed-out dates shown to users with no explanation
Some cards are clipped or have weird empty space next to them
The really useful summary (what it never does) is buried at the very bottom
